value.title: Spawn storm: the daemon and status line stop launching processes
value.summary: Defender's EDR inspects every process launch, and pij launched ~2/3 of the Mac Studio's ~741/s: the daemon forked tmux/ps per pane per tick, the Copilot status line ~20 processes per refresh. Reads move to one tmux control-mode client; the status line becomes one process.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Vaughan, 27 Oct 23:3x: 'fix it and do it' (brief: prime pij-broad-rykard). Baseline 23:43: 741 new processes/s machine-wide; the pij-rs daemon's children 250-480/s (~90% tmux, ~9% ps), the pij status line >=40/s; Defender ~1.7 cores (epsext 83%, wdavdaemon_enterprise 47%, wdavdaemon 27%, log 10%). Root causes: the pane observer forks show-options + display-message + capture-pane per tracked pane every 600 ms; liveness forks `ps` per check; the plan-156 status line forks ~20 per refresh and calls `pij-rs whoami`. Closes the daemon half of pij-fleet#62. Stacked on #71 so a deploy cannot drop Telegram files.

sections.name: goals
value: Steady-state pij reads launch no process.
The status line is one process per refresh with identical bytes.
Every answer stays the same; control mode is never worse than forking.

sections.name: non_goals
value: Changing what the observer, liveness or status line decide.
Defender configuration (EDR cannot be excluded by users).

value.claim: Daemon tmux reads launch no process. pij-tmux answers list-panes, capture-pane, display-message -p and show-options over ONE persistent `tmux -u -C attach-session -f no-output,ignore-size,read-only` client. After warm-up (list-sessions + attach), 25 rounds of every observer/status read on 3 panes launch zero tmux processes. Writes (set-option, pipe-pane, send-keys, paste/load-buffer, kill, new-window) still fork. An argument the client cannot single-quote forks.

Same answers. Control answers equal the forked client's byte for byte, under a no-LANG environment (the launchd case `-u` exists for), including tabs, non-ASCII and a pane line that looks like a control frame; errors carry the same text (`can't find pane: %999`); tmux 3.6's exit-0-empty display-message for a missing pane keeps today's behaviour (parity, not a fix).

Never worse than forking. Control mode only replaces a forked read with the same command. Off, starting, slow (3 s), lost (detached, %exit) or server gone: that call forks as today; a lost client is replaced (start backoff 5 s); a dead server is a plain error within 5 s, not a hang. The daemon composes control mode (`new`, `with_legacy_tap_root`); fake executables (`with_binary`) opt in.

Status line: one process per refresh. `pij-rs statusline copilot` replaces the plan-156 bash script's body (the managed script becomes `exec pij-rs statusline copilot`): whoami in-process over HTTP (no CLI process), branch from .git/HEAD (git only for a detached HEAD), effort read once, no jq/awk/cat/basename. Output bytes identical to the plan-156 script over a golden corpus (ok, dead, unregistered, daemon down, FYIs, effort files, branch, detached, no repo, AIU, premium, duration).

Honest by construction (plan 156 rule 5). The pane is asked, never an inherited PIJ_SESSION_ID. A dead seat shows dead on the next render: the staleness bound is one refresh, with no cache. Mutant: drop the per-render ask; the dead-seat golden goes red.

Acceptance measured with harness/scripts/spawn-rate.py (total from PID-counter deltas; daemon children by ppid) and `top -l 2 -o cpu` for Defender, before and after each deploy, same fleet: total new processes drop >=80% from the 741/s baseline, and pij-rs plus the status line together stay under 10/s. The `ps` share of daemon launches (~9% at baseline) is re-measured after deploy 1; a ps-free liveness (needs a new safe sysctl dependency, since unsafe_code is forbidden) is a ruling if it is still needed.

Proof. RED shown for each behaviour; mutants on control framing, the handshake, quoting, the read allowlist, the production default and client replacement; cargo fmt, clippy -D warnings, scoped tests; pre-existing load flakes shown on the unchanged base; GitHub CI green on the exact head. Anything not run is NOT RUN with its reason.

Deploy as plan 179 on the prime's word: build in this worktree, relink /opt/homebrew/bin/pij-rs, bounce the daemon in %2, reinstall the status line, extensions_reload. Rollback: relink to d05776df (90668c0). Stacked on #71 (unmerged), so the deploy keeps Telegram file support. docs/how/macos-defender.md says what changed and how to measure it.
